full_catalogues: Cache-only full query responses and unexamined experimental metadata. They are not publication evidence or evaluated clinical rosters; no compact full bibliography exported.
committed: Selected actually inspected source-method/identity/condition records, source receipt hashes, plans/amendments, pending scopes, decisions and source-only validation.
recovery: Use exact ordinary EPMC URLs in source receipts; API versions can change bytes. Exact local raw cache is not portable in fresh checkout. No successful supplement acquisition claimed; route-specific failures and unverified publisher URL mapping persist.
no_raw_download_requirement: A fresh checkout can verify committed export hashes and method decisions, but exact raw source replay requires authorized matching cached originals or actual successful ordinary recovery.
images: No source images/UI/browser/headless viewed or executed. No TIFF/PPTX/collection body retained from failed routes.
other_lanes: Perfusion and circulating-burden sources owned elsewhere; do not duplicate or equate their measurements with oxygen.
